description: Get the Visamundi payment link for a complete application. Give this link to the traveller: they review the application, accept the terms and pay there. Also returns `estimatedDelivery` (null when unavailable): `latestDate` (YYYY-MM-DD) is an estimate, never a guarantee; always state it together with `condition`, and with `cappedExplanation` when `cappedFarTrip` is true (issuance deliberately scheduled closer to a distant trip). Fails with the list of missing fields if the application is incomplete.

applicationId.description: applicationId returned by the first save_application call.

resumeToken.description: resumeToken returned by the first save_application call. Keep it private.

name: get_payment_link
